paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the F1 score for several datasets when utilizing different MADLLM models. The horizontal axis represents the dataset names, arranged alphabetically in descending order: WADI, MSL, SMAP, SWAT, WaT, PSM, SMD, and MADLLM w/o feature embedding, MADLLM w/o skip embedding, and MADLLM. The vertical axis represents the F1 score as a percentage, ranging from approximately 65% to 90%. The scale is linear, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 5%, beginning at 65% and ending at 95%. The MADLLM w/o feature embedding bar is approximately 82%, the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar is approximately 86%, and the MADLLM bar is approximately 91%. All other bars representing the different datasets are visually distinct in color – green for MADLLM, blue for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, and orange for MADLLM w/o skip embedding – and their heights range from approximately 68% to 78%.
